test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A particular locality is focusing on three R’s - Recycle, Reuse and Reduce - to decrease the production of non-biodegradable waste. What will be the correct sequence to follow them?
solution:
the correct answer is '__Reduce, Reuse, Recycle__'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The three R's – Reduce, Reuse, Recycle – all help to cut down on the amount of waste by decreasing the production of non-biodegradable waste.
 
• They **conserve natural resources, landfill space and energy.**
 
• Plus, the three R's save land and money communities must use to dispose of waste in landfills. Siting a new landfill has become difficult and more expensive due to environmental regulations and public opposition
